CAD kyauta don ƙirar ban ruwa ta matsi

Zana, auna girma kuma ka rubuta bayanan tsarin ban ruwa ta ɗigo, ƙananan masu fesa ruwa, masu fesa ruwa da pivot na tsakiya. Kai tsaye a mai binciken gizo, ba tare da girka komai ba, kuma ayyukanka suna zama a kwamfutarka.

Buɗe manhajar Koyarwa mai mu'amala Duba misalai da aka shirya

Ana loda CAD na ban ruwa…

OpenCADIrrigation yana haɗa zanen CAD, hanyar sadarwar ruwa da lissafi wuri ɗaya: zana iyakar wurin, shimfiɗa layukan lateral, bawuloli da babban bututu, danna F5 ka samu girman bututu, matsi, daidaito, jadawalin aiki, jerin kayan aiki da rahotanni a shirye don bugawa. Akwai shi a harsuna 20, yana bin harshen kwamfutarka.

Abin da OpenCADIrrigation yake yi

  • Cikakken zanen CAD

    Layi, polyline, baka, spline, zanen cikewa (hatch), ma'auni, rubutu da layers, tare da snap, zaɓi ta taga, grips da gajerun umarni irin na AutoCAD (L, PL, C, D, ZE…).

  • Hanyar sadarwar ruwa

    Tushen ruwa, famfo, babban bututu, bawul na yanki, layukan lateral masu fitar da ruwa, tef da bututun ɗigo, matattara, masu daidaita matsi, mitocin ruwa da mahaɗai; masu samar da rukunin lateral da grid na masu fesa ruwa.

  • Ingantaccen injin lissafin ruwa

    Hazen-Williams da Darcy-Weisbach, ƙananan asarar matsi, masu fitar da ruwa q = k·Hˣ, warware hanyar sadarwa da Global Gradient Algorithm (kamar EPANET), lanƙwasan famfo da wurin aiki, bugun ruwa da nazarin wanke bututu.

  • Auna girma ta atomatik

    Linear programming ko iyakar gudun ruwa, bisa tagar matsin masu fitar da ruwa da ajin bututu, tare da daidaita kuɗin bututu da na makamashi, girman bututu a matakai da jadawalin aiki.

  • Ƙasa da tuddai

    Layukan tsayi, wuraren tsayi, samfurin ƙasa na dijital ta triangulation, tsayin ƙasa da ake saukewa daga intanet ta coordinate, bayanan tsayi a tsawon layi da layin matsi a saman ƙasa.

  • Rahotanni da kayan aiki

    Yankuna, bututu, masu fitar da ruwa, daidaito (CU, DU, EU), bukatun ruwan amfanin gona, shirin na'urar sarrafawa da jerin kayan aiki tare da haɗe-haɗe; fitarwa zuwa PDF, Excel, CSV da TXT.

  • Musayar fayiloli

    Yana shigo da DXF, DWG, KML/KMZ, SHP, CSV/XYZ, GeoTIFF da hotuna masu georeference; yana fitar da DXF, DWG, takardun PDF, SVG, KML, KMZ da GeoJSON.

  • Kundin masana'antun

    Kundin masana'antun a JSON (Netafim, Rivulis, Jain, Toro, Rain Bird, Nelson, Hunter, NaanDanJain, Senninger) a shirye don amfani, da kuma fakitinka da ake lodawa daga fayil ko URL.

Yadda yake aiki

  1. Zana ko shigo da wurin. Kawo DXF, DWG, KML ko hoton tauraron ɗan adam, ko ka zana gona, lambu ko fili kai tsaye. Ƙara layukan tsayi ko sauke tsayin ƙasa ta coordinate.
  2. Gina hanyar sadarwa. Samar da rukunin lateral ko grid na masu fesa ruwa da danna ɗaya, sanya bawuloli, famfo da tushen ruwa, sannan ka haɗa komai da babban bututu.
  3. Yi ƙira ka rubuta bayanai. Danna F5: manhajar tana auna girman yankuna da babban bututu, tana duba matsi da gudun ruwa, kuma tana samar da rahotanni, jerin kayan aiki da takardar PDF.

Misalai a shirye don buɗewa

Kowane aiki yana buɗewa cikakke kuma ana ƙira shi da F5. Yi amfani da su don sanin manhajar ko a matsayin mafari.

  • Gonar 'ya'yan itace

    Ƙananan masu fesa ruwa a lemu da ɗigo a inabi, rijiya da famfo da tace, ƙasa mai gangara.

  • Lambun gida

    Fesa na pop-up a ciyawar gaba, rotors a baya da ɗigo a lambu, daga ruwan famfo na gari da mita da mai hana komawar ruwa.

  • Filin ƙwallon ƙafa

    Cikakken fili na m 105 × 68 mai masu fesa ruwa na bugu a layuka biyar, tafki, famfo da zangunan dare.

  • Amfanin gona na layi da ɗigo

    Rukunin tumatir huɗu a kan tef ɗin ɗigo, manifolds da bawuloli, tace mai raga, famfo da ƙasa mai gangara.

  • Pivot na tsakiya

    Pivot na m 300 a masara da babban bututu, rijiya da famfo ke ciyarwa; rahoton hasumiya, tsawo da bakin fesawa.

  • Gidan ganye na kayan lambu

    Ramuka huɗu na barkono a kan bututun ɗigo mai daidaita matsi, yanki ɗaya ga kowane rami, tanki, ƙaramin famfo da tace mai faifai.

  • Gandun shuke-shuke

    Lambuna uku na m 12 × 48 ƙarƙashin ƙananan masu fesa ruwa na sama a grid na m 4 × 4, yanki ɗaya ga kowane lambu, tanki mai tsayi, ƙaramin famfo da tace mai faifai.

  • Kofi a layukan tsayi

    Rukunin kofi uku a gangaren tudu masu laterals masu lanƙwasa da ke bin layukan tsayi (rukunin jagora), bututun ɗigo na PC, rijiya da famfo a gindin gangara.

  • Gonar ayaba

    Rukunin ayaba biyu ƙarƙashin ƙananan masu fesa ruwa masu daidaita matsi a m 5 × 5, rijiya da famfon nutsewa, tace mai faifai da ƙasa mai gangara.

  • Rake da ɗigo na ƙarƙashin ƙasa

    Rukunin rake biyu a kan bututun ɗigo na PC na mm 20 da aka binne m 0.3, laterals na m 180, manifolds da aka binne, tafki, famfo, tace mai raga da bawul na iska.

  • Ɗigo ta nauyi

    Tafki m 40 sama da rukunin kayan lambu biyu masu ɗigo, ba tare da famfo ba: bawul na ƙofa, bawul na rage matsi da tace mai faifai a babban bututu; layukan tsayi na gangara.

  • Makiyaya da fesa ruwa

    Filaye uku na m 72 × 72 masu layukan masu fesa ruwa na bugu a m 12 × 18, manifolds da bawuloli, tafki, famfo da bawul na hana komawa.

  • Ramin golf

    Tee da fesa, fairway da rotors a grid na triangular (yankuna biyu) da green da rotors kewaye da gefe, tafki da famfo da zangunan dare.

  • Pivot na sashe da bindigar ƙarshe

    Pivot na m 250 a waken soya da ke juyawa 270°, yana barin kwata na gidan gona a buɗe, da bindigar ƙarshe ta m³/h 12; tafki, famfo na hp 30 da bawul na ƙofa.

  • Injin layi

    Injin layi na m 392 a alkama da ke tafiya m 800 tare da magudanar ruwa, ɗaukar ruwa da famfo na hp 30 da bawul na hana komawa; rahoton hasumiya da bakin fesawa.

Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi

Shin OpenCADIrrigation kyauta ne?
Ee. Kyauta ne don aikin ƙwararru, ilimi da amfanin kai, ba tare da yin rajista ba.
Shin sai na girka wani abu?
A'a. Yana aiki a Chrome, Edge, Firefox da Safari, a kwamfuta, tablet da waya, kuma ana iya girka shi a matsayin manhaja (PWA) mai buɗewa a tagarta.
Shin ana ajiye ayyukana a gajimare (cloud)?
A'a. Ana ajiye ayyuka a mai binciken gizonka da kuma a fayilolin .oci.json da kake ajiyewa inda kake so. Tsayin ƙasa na intanet da taswirorin bango ne kaɗai ke amfani da intanet, idan ka nema.
Shin yana aiki da AutoCAD da sauran CAD?
Ee. Yana shigo da fitar da DXF da DWG (AutoCAD 2000 zuwa 2018), da KML/KMZ na Google Earth, shapefile, GeoJSON, SVG da PDF.
A waɗanne harsuna ake samunsa?
A harsuna 20, iri ɗaya da na wannan shafin (jerin yana ƙasan shafin). Manhajar tana buɗewa a harshen kwamfutarka kuma kana iya canzawa kowane lokaci a Kallo → Harshe.
